bucket_point_count_definition: Number of (MSM row, point column) digit occurrences in the signed bucket; positive and negative buckets are separate. The original point_count field is preserved and duplicated as point_occurrence_count.
unique_point_count_definition: Number of distinct fixed point-column positions i that appear at least once in the signed bucket across all K MSM rows.
point_reuse_statistics_definition: A point is reused when the same fixed point-column appears in the same signed bucket in at least two MSM rows. Multiplicity is counted across MSM rows.
exact_mask_statistics_definition: Exact-mask fields are computed on the initially built tile-local masks before multiscale projection or residual submask splitting. With tile_size < K, one fixed point may contribute one mask record to multiple active tiles.
